notes: I replaced the single-sigmoid model with a blend of two linear regimes (left slope ≈ -0.53, right slope ≈ -0.2) joined by a sigmoid transition centered near x≈6 with width ≈6. This captures the observed piecewise-linear tails and the steeper middle that the old model missed (e.g. E4's steep drop from -5.9 to 12.5 and shallow right tail).
